title: libre 2 oop algorithm
symptom: When using the OOP algorithm with Libre 2, calibrated values are transferred to AndroidAPS, but uncalibrated values are transmitted to Nightscout, making evaluation or monitoring by Nightscout incorrect.
cause: The OOP algorithm cannot be calibrated, and the raw data from Libre 2 has a minimum value of 40, which prevents large intercept calibration. The thread also indicates that the issue is related to the calibration plugin not being applied to data sent to Nightscout.
fix: RainerTischnet describes a workaround: connect MM2 with xDrip, enable OOP algorithm, then in settings/advanced settings/advanced calibration choose 'xDrip original', calibrate, then export settings to XML, edit the XML to set 'calibrate_external_libre_algorithm' to true, import settings back, and set calibration plugin to none. This allows normal calibration to run with Nightscout and AAPS.
evidence_quote: the trick is: connect the mm2 with xdrip, enable oop algorithm. if you see the values. settings / advanced settings / advanced calibration choose xdrip original. back to the xdrip start desktop. then there should be a P now. now you have to calibrate first. then save import / export settings. settings on SD card. save all settings on sd card. I don't have an SD card. the backup can be found under download / xdrip-export. I use the total commander app to send the xml to google drive. then edit on pc xml with notepad ++ enable true at calibrate_external_libre_algorithm.
